dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a smooth, shallow concave spline curvature from the posterior insertion point to the apex.

dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Anterior margin maintains a consistent slope of approximately 45-50 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Estimated 2.0:1 ratio between the visible base width and the vertical height from the dorsal ridge.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large-radius convex arc forming a smooth, rounded forehead profile.

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow obtuse angle visible where the melon's descent meets the dorsal plane of the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent visibility of both pectoral fins and ocular region; uniform turquoise-toned pixel values across the entire visible fuselage.
